text:
Marta: Heads-up: big enterprise asked for a concise artifact showing audit capture, BYOK proof, retention policy, and SOC2 mapping. Need a scoped PoC we can demo in 3 weeks.

Owen: TL;DR proposal for PoC scope:
- events: auth, admin-config, model_invocation_meta
- hot index: 90d searchable; archive: 7y immutable objects
- keys: tenant KEK (customer KMS) + platform envelope keys
- export: signed NDJSON manifest + encrypted blobs + audit-attestation

Zara: Legal asks: include chain-of-custody for holds/unholds, redaction decisions, and a short SOC2 mapping PDF. Also call out EU-specific pseudonymization options.

Dev: Engineering constraints: hot index for 90d increases cost ~2x; search SLA p95 metadata <250ms. Archive retrieval async (hours). Implementation sketch: daily shard -> snapshot -> put-object(WORM) with manifest.

Marta: Acceptance criteria (PoC):
1) demo tenant can produce export bundle (<=200GB) with signed manifest
2) show tenant KEK provisioning + rotation logs
3) run legal-hold toggle that prevents deletion and records approver
4) deliver SOC2 mapping doc and sample exported events

LegalBot: Reminder: signed manifests + append-only audit index required for tamper evidence. Include timestamped admin identities.

Owen: Tentative owners: index + search = Dev; export assembly = Owen + Dev; KMS flows = Marta + Dev; legal controls = Zara.

ops-bot: @channel meeting scheduled Thu 10:00 "EU retention & BYOK PoC kickoff" (zoom link).

Zara: I'll draft the redaction profiles (strict/pseudonymize/none) and SOC2 checklist by Tue.

Dev: I'll draft a minimal RFC for lifecycle + manifest schema today. If no blockers, slot into next sprint.

Marta: Thanks team — please add must-haves here before Wed EOD.
